name: Michael Massee
bio: Michael Massee (September 1, 1952 – October 20, 2016) was an American actor perhaps best known for his roles as villains in film and television. On March 31, 1993, he accidentally shot and killed actor Brandon Lee on the set of The Crow (1994).
